results.corrected_title: Modal Labs raises $750 million Series D at a $15.75 billion valuation
results.corrected_summary: AI inference infrastructure company Modal Labs, co-founded and led by CEO Erik Bernhardsson, raised a $750 million Series D led by Accel at a $15.75 billion post-money valuation. Kleiner Perkins joined, and existing investors including Menlo Ventures, General Catalyst, Redpoint, Lux Capital and Bain Capital Ventures took part. The company says its annual revenue run rate has passed $1 billion. Crunchbase ranked it the largest US startup funding round of the week of Oct. 10-16; the valuation is more than triple the $4.65 billion from the May Series C.
key_facts: Prior Series C (May 2026): $355M at about $4.65B valuation
Company-stated annual revenue run rate above $1B
Largest US funding round of Oct. 10-16 per Crunchbase
results.issues: Announced 2026-10-14. The $1B run rate is the company's own figure. Bernhardsson being Swedish was not checked in the sources opened. Crunchbase's ranking covers US-based startups only.

results.corrected_title: Kripos: AI-generated child abuse material cases in 2026 already exceed all of 2025
results.corrected_summary: NRK reports that Kripos has registered 395 cases involving AI-generated child sexual abuse material so far in 2026, with three months of the year left. That is already more than the 385 cases recorded in all of 2025. Sør-Øst police district says over 10 percent of its abuse tips now involve such material, and it calls for law changes and more responsibility from technology companies.
key_facts: 395 cases registered by Kripos so far in 2026
Sør-Øst police district: over 10% of its abuse tips involve AI-generated material
Police call for law changes, better technical measures and more responsibility from tech companies
Tech expert Torgeir Waterhouse: AI companies have a legal and ethical responsibility to build in safeguards
results.issues: Only one source (NRK), but it is reliable and quotes Kripos (Helge Haugland) directly. Published 2026-10-15, updated 2026-10-16. The calls for law changes come mainly from Sør-Øst police district (Thea Muri), not from Kripos itself.
